title: Deterministic coefficient cost
statement: Let the output dimension be a positive integer $n$, let the requested bias be a positive rational number at most $1/2$, and let the integral Fourier $1$-norm bound be an integer at least $1$. For a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates, define the coefficient cost as the sum of a cost charging the deterministic small-bias computation in work and the coefficient query-batch cost, augmented by work equal to the family’s cardinality times the coefficient local computation work; the added work charges have zero random examples and zero membership queries.
hypotheses_covered: Positive rational bias encoded by a positive numerator and denominator
Encoded bias at most one half
caveat: The deterministic small-bias work, query-batch cost, and coefficient sample count are referenced but not defined in the supplied statement.
